author: Mark Atwood
text: Protocol for external AI sessions (Opus, coordinators, one-off agents): file and update beads ONLY via scripts/beads-safe.sh (<bd subcommand> [args]) — it takes the sync lock, runs bd, and checkpoint-commits the store before releasing. Bare bd from a non-fleet session is what got the orchestrator's decompositions rewound (the ldzz rescue happened because of it). Reads need no wrapper.
